post.description: Create an AccordTrace service-recorded proof bound to the canonical SHA-256 digest of submitted JSON-compatible data. Submitted data is not stored in the proof record. When an Ed25519 issuer key is configured the proof also carries an issuer signature; otherwise integrity_mode is service_recorded_hash and issuer is null. JSON requests are bounded to 1 MiB, depth 128 and 100,000 nodes including the envelope.

503.description: A configured issuer signing key is invalid

413.description: Request exceeds 1 MiB, nesting depth 128 or 100,000 JSON nodes (including the request envelope).

405.description: Method not allowed; supported methods are listed in Allow.
